title: enzo hub hb
script:
-- GUI
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game.CoreGui)
local Main = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel", Main)
local ToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", Main)

ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

-- Main
Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 140)
Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0.4, 0)
Main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0)
Main.BorderSizePixel = 0
Main.Active = true
Main.Draggable = true

-- Title
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 60)
Title.Text = "enzo hub x6"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Title.TextScaled = true
Title.BorderSizePixel = 0

-- Button
ToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 60)
ToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 60)
ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
ToggleBtn.TextScaled = true
ToggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
ToggleBtn.Text = "Ativar Hitbox x6 OFF"

-- lógica do toggle
local isOn = false

_G.HeadSize = 8
_G.Disabled = false

local function Toggle()
    isOn = not isOn
    if isOn then
        ToggleBtn.Text = "Ativar Hitbox x6 ON"
        _G.Disabled = true
    else
        ToggleBtn.Text = "Ativar Hitbox x6 OFF"
        _G.Disabled = false
    end
end

ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(Toggle)

-- TECLA T PARA ATIVAR/DESATIVAR
game:GetService("UserInputService").InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if gpe then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then
        Toggle()
    end
end)

-- SCRIPT DA HITBOX (agora desliga 100%)
game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    for _,v in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
        if v.Name ~= game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Name then
            local char = v.Character
            if char and char:FindFirstChild("Head") then
                local head = char.Head

                if _G.Disabled then
                    -- HITBOX LIGADA
                    pcall(function()
                        head.Size = Vector3.new(_G.HeadSize,_G.HeadSize,_G.HeadSize)
                        head.Transparency = 1
                        head.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Red")
                        head.Material = "Neon"
                        head.CanCollide = false
                        head.Massless = true
                    end)
                else
                    -- HITBOX DESLIGADA
                    pcall(function()
                        head.Size = Vector3.new(2, 1, 1)
                        head.Transparency = 0
                        head.Material = "Plastic"
                        head.CanCollide = false
                        head.Massless = false
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
